title: Comparative Framework Analysis for Enterprise Generative AI Applications: Chatbot, Automation, and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration
abstract: arXiv:2609.13577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study compares framework suitability across three classes of enterprise generative AI applications: a documentation-based development assistant, an email and inquiry automation system, and an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration tool. The analysis evaluates component boundaries, orchestration, policy retrieval or reasoning, model integration, deterministic validation, persistence, observability, and operational efficiency. Across the three applications, the evidence supports layered architectures in which probabilistic components generate proposals, while deterministic components retain authority over routing, authorization, validation, persistence, idempotency, and final outcomes. The results indicate that framework suitability depends on the application, deployment conditions, and component responsibility: search quality, workflow control, safety behavior, and migration validation cannot be reduced to a single cross-application assessme

translated_title: 企业级生成式AI应用的比较框架分析：聊天机器人、自动化与Oracle到PostgreSQL迁移
translated_abstract: 本研究比较了三类企业级生成式AI应用的框架适用性：基于文档的开发助手、邮件与咨询自动化系统，以及Oracle到PostgreSQL的迁移工具。该分析评估了组件边界、编排、策略检索或推理、模型集成、确定性验证、持久化、可观测性和运营效率。在三个应用中，证据均支持采用分层架构，即由概率性组件生成建议，而确定性组件保留对路由、授权、验证、持久化、幂等性和最终结果的控制权。结果表明，框架适用性取决于具体应用、部署条件和组件职责：搜索质量、工作流控制、安全行为和迁移验证无法简化为单一的跨应用评估。
tldr: 本研究通过对三类企业级生成式AI应用的框架比较分析，证明分层架构（概率性组件生成建议、确定性组件掌控关键控制权）最为有效，且框架适用性必须结合具体应用场景进行评估。
en_tdlr: This comparative study of three enterprise generative AI applications demonstrates that layered architectures—with probabilistic components generating proposals and deterministic components retaining authority over routing, validation, and final outcomes—are most effective, and framework suitability must be assessed per application rather than universally.
